contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman silver coin, Siliqua of Constantius II (AD 337-361), Reece period 18 (AD 348-364). Arles mint (AD 355-360), RIC VII Arles 261/91; Hoxne 84. Posible die flaw in obverse right field. Obverse: Diademed, draped, cuirassed bust right. Legend: DN CONSTAN-TIVS P F AVG. Reverse: VOTIS/XXX/MVLTIS/XXXX within wreath. Mint mark: -/-//SCON. Die axis: 6 o'clock.
